snippet.title: The Skin Stapler - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
🔪 COMING AUGUST 6: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4310610/The_Skin_Stapler/

The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

▬ Tainted Pact ▬▬▬▬▬▬

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/assemble-entertainment
Newsletter: https://mailchi.mp/assembleteam/assemble-newsletter
Website: http://www.assembleteam.com/

Assemble Entertainment is an independent publisher based in Germany, best known for indie hits such as Sticky Business, Roadwarden, Decktamer, Paddle Paddle Paddle, Grind Survivors and the Endzone franchise. Since 2016, Assemble has released more than 50 games across different genres, including cozy, horror, strategy and roguelike, and has established itself as a trusted partner for bringing original indie projects to market.
